Recorded claim:
`_updateCurrentIndexClasses()` is the sole owner of `aria-activedescendant` from `currentIndex`. A cancelled primary press on row 2 proved the stale mousedown assignment could point to row 2 while selection/current row remained row 1; regression coverage belongs in `mail/base/test/browser/widgets/browser_treeView.js` with normal click checks left enabled. [Task 1]
